asked.question: A full joint probability distribution for the Toothache, Cavity and catch world is given below. | | toothache, catch | toothache, ¬catch | ¬toothache, catch | ¬toothache, ¬catch | |---|---|---|---|---| | cavity | 0.108 | 0.012 | 0.072 | 0.008 | | ¬cavity | 0.016 | 0.064 | 0.144 | 0.576 |
Knowledge কী? Human Knowledge কে Computer এ প্রকাশ করার একটি flow diagram দেখান।
What is an expert system? Explain its components.

mustKnow.en: Knowledge Representation (KR) is the formal, machine-processable encoding of information about the world so an AI system can store it and reason, infer and decide over it.
mustKnow.bn: Knowledge Representation (KR) হলো জগৎ সম্পর্কিত তথ্যকে এমন formal, machine-processable আকারে encode করা যাতে একটি AI system তা store করে reason, infer ও decide করতে পারে।

mustKnow.en: The four building blocks of a knowledge base are fact (a basic assertion), rule (a conditional linking facts), ontology (the concepts and relations of a domain) and inference (deriving new knowledge).
mustKnow.bn: Knowledge base-এর চারটি building block: fact (মৌলিক assertion), rule (fact-দের যুক্তকারী conditional), ontology (domain-এর concept ও relation) এবং inference (নতুন জ্ঞান derive করা)।

mustKnow.en: The six classic KR schemes are logical (PL/FOL), semantic network, frame, production rule, script and ontology.
mustKnow.bn: ছয়টি classic KR scheme: logical (PL/FOL), semantic network, frame, production rule, script এবং ontology।

mustKnow.en: A KR scheme is judged by representational adequacy, inferential adequacy, inferential efficiency and ease of acquisition.
mustKnow.bn: একটি KR scheme-কে বিচার করা হয় representational adequacy, inferential adequacy, inferential efficiency এবং ease of acquisition দিয়ে।

mustKnow.en: Semantic network = Quillian, 1968; frames = Minsky, 1975; scripts = Schank & Abelson, 1977; resolution = Robinson, 1965.
mustKnow.bn: Semantic network = Quillian, ১৯৬৮; frames = Minsky, ১৯৭৫; scripts = Schank ও Abelson, ১৯৭৭; resolution = Robinson, ১৯৬৫।

mustKnow.en: A semantic network is a directed graph: nodes = objects/concepts, labelled arcs = relations (IS-A, HAS-A, PART-OF). It gives inheritance for free but has no formal semantics and cannot prove anything.
mustKnow.bn: Semantic network একটি directed graph: node = object/concept, labelled arc = relation (IS-A, HAS-A, PART-OF)। এটি বিনামূল্যে inheritance দেয় কিন্তু এর formal semantics নেই এবং কিছু prove করতে পারে না।

mustKnow.en: IS-A goes subclass → superclass only: 'a dog IS-A mammal' is valid, 'a mammal IS-A dog' is not.
mustKnow.bn: IS-A কেবল subclass → superclass দিকে যায়: 'a dog IS-A mammal' সঠিক, 'a mammal IS-A dog' নয়।

mustKnow.en: A frame is a data structure for a stereotyped object/class: a name plus slots, each holding a value, a facet (default/range/if-needed procedure) or a link. A class frame is a schema; a filled one is an instance.
mustKnow.bn: Frame হলো stereotyped object/class-এর জন্য data structure: একটি name ও slot-সমূহ, প্রতিটি slot একটি value, facet (default/range/if-needed procedure) বা link ধারণ করে। Class frame একটি schema; পূরণ করা frame একটি instance।

mustKnow.en: A script (Schank & Abelson) is a stereotyped ordered sequence of events; its five parts are initial conditions, states/events, transitions, resulting conditions and props (roles).
mustKnow.bn: Script (Schank ও Abelson) হলো ঘটনার একটি stereotyped ordered sequence; এর পাঁচ অংশ: initial conditions, states/events, transitions, resulting conditions এবং props (ভূমিকা)।

mustKnow.en: In propositional logic P → Q is false only when P is true and Q is false; it is logically equivalent to ¬P ∨ Q.
mustKnow.bn: Propositional logic-এ P → Q কেবল তখনই false যখন P true ও Q false; এটি logically ¬P ∨ Q-এর সমতুল্য।

mustKnow.en: The contrapositive of P → Q is ¬Q → ¬P and is equivalent to it. The converse Q → P and the inverse ¬P → ¬Q are NOT equivalent to P → Q.
mustKnow.bn: P → Q-এর contrapositive হলো ¬Q → ¬P এবং এটি সমতুল্য। Converse Q → P ও inverse ¬P → ¬Q, P → Q-এর সমতুল্য নয়।

mustKnow.en: A tautology (valid) is true for every assignment; a contradiction (unsatisfiable) is false for every assignment; a satisfiable formula is true for at least one. n propositions give 2ⁿ truth-table rows.
mustKnow.bn: Tautology (valid) প্রতিটি assignment-এ true; contradiction (unsatisfiable) প্রতিটি assignment-এ false; satisfiable formula অন্তত একটি assignment-এ true। n টি proposition দেয় 2ⁿ টি truth-table row।

mustKnow.en: Modus ponens: from P and P → Q conclude Q. Modus tollens: from ¬Q and P → Q conclude ¬P.
mustKnow.bn: Modus ponens: P ও P → Q থেকে Q। Modus tollens: ¬Q ও P → Q থেকে ¬P।

mustKnow.en: Resolution: from (P ∨ Q) and (¬P ∨ R) conclude (Q ∨ R) — drop the complementary pair P/¬P and keep the rest joined by ∨, never ∧.
mustKnow.bn: Resolution: (P ∨ Q) ও (¬P ∨ R) থেকে (Q ∨ R) — complementary জোড়া P/¬P বাদ দিয়ে বাকিগুলো ∨ দিয়ে যুক্ত রাখা হয়, কখনো ∧ নয়।

mustKnow.en: First-order logic adds objects, predicates, functions and the quantifiers ∀ (for all) and ∃ (there exists) to propositional logic.
mustKnow.bn: First-order logic, propositional logic-এর সাথে object, predicate, function এবং quantifier ∀ (for all) ও ∃ (there exists) যোগ করে।

mustKnow.en: 'All humans are mortal' = ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)); using ∧ instead of → would wrongly claim everything is both human and mortal. Quantifier order matters: ∃x∀y ≠ ∀x∃y.
mustKnow.bn: 'All humans are mortal' = ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)); → এর বদলে ∧ দিলে ভুলভাবে বলা হবে সবকিছুই human ও mortal। Quantifier-এর ক্রম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ: ∃x∀y ≠ ∀x∃y।

mustKnow.en: Unification finds a substitution that makes two atoms identical; the result is the most general unifier (MGU). The occurs check forbids binding a variable to a term containing it (X = f(X) fails).
mustKnow.bn: Unification এমন substitution খোঁজে যা দুটি atom-কে অভিন্ন করে; ফল হলো most general unifier (MGU)। Occurs check একটি variable-কে নিজেকে ধারণকারী term-এর সাথে bind করতে দেয় না (X = f(X) ব্যর্থ)।

mustKnow.en: A Horn clause has at most one positive literal (H ← B₁ ∧ … ∧ Bₙ). Forward and backward chaining are both complete for Horn knowledge, and Horn logic is monotonic.
mustKnow.bn: Horn clause-এ সর্বোচ্চ একটি positive literal থাকে (H ← B₁ ∧ … ∧ Bₙ)। Horn knowledge-এর জন্য forward ও backward chaining উভয়ই complete, এবং Horn logic monotonic।

mustKnow.en: Forward chaining is data-driven / bottom-up (start from facts); backward chaining is goal-driven / top-down (start from the goal). Both are sound; resolution is needed for non-Horn (disjunctive) knowledge.
mustKnow.bn: Forward chaining data-driven / bottom-up (fact থেকে শুরু); backward chaining goal-driven / top-down (goal থেকে শুরু)। উভয়ই sound; non-Horn (disjunctive) knowledge-এর জন্য resolution লাগে।

mustKnow.en: Refutation by resolution proves a goal φ by adding ¬φ to the clauses and deriving the empty clause (a contradiction); resolution is sound and refutation-complete for FOL (Robinson, 1965).
mustKnow.bn: Refutation by resolution একটি goal φ prove করে ¬φ clause-গুলোতে যোগ করে empty clause (contradiction) derive করার মাধ্যমে; resolution sound এবং FOL-এর জন্য refutation-complete (Robinson, ১৯৬৫)।

question.en: How many rows does the truth table of (P ∧ Q) → (R ∨ S) have?
question.bn: (P ∧ Q) → (R ∨ S)-এর truth table-এ কয়টি row থাকবে?

working.en: There are 4 distinct propositions P, Q, R, S, so the table has 2⁴ rows.
working.bn: ৪টি distinct proposition P, Q, R, S আছে, তাই table-এ 2⁴ টি row।

formulas.formula: P → Q ≡ ¬P ∨ Q   (false only when P = T, Q = F)

question.en: Rewrite 'If it rains then the match is cancelled' (R → C) without →, and give its clause form.
question.bn: 'If it rains then the match is cancelled' (R → C)-কে → ছাড়া লেখো এবং এর clause form দাও।

working.en: Replace → using P → Q ≡ ¬P ∨ Q: R → C becomes ¬R ∨ C. This single clause is already in CNF.
working.bn: P → Q ≡ ¬P ∨ Q দিয়ে → সরাই: R → C হয় ¬R ∨ C। এই একটি clause ইতিমধ্যে CNF-এ আছে।

formulas.formula: P → Q ≡ ¬Q → ¬P   (converse Q → P and inverse ¬P → ¬Q are NOT equivalent)

question.en: Give the contrapositive of 'If a number is divisible by 4 then it is even' and state whether it is equivalent to the original.
question.bn: 'If a number is divisible by 4 then it is even'-এর contrapositive দাও এবং এটি মূলটির সমতুল্য কিনা বলো।

working.en: P = divisible by 4, Q = even. Contrapositive ¬Q → ¬P: 'If a number is not even then it is not divisible by 4.' This is logically equivalent to the original.
working.bn: P = 4 দ্বারা বিভাজ্য, Q = জোড়। Contrapositive ¬Q → ¬P: 'If a number is not even then it is not divisible by 4।' এটি মূলটির logically সমতুল্য।

example.answer: If not even, then not divisible by 4 — equivalent

formulas.formula: (α ∨ P), (β ∨ ¬P) ⊢ (α ∨ β)   — cancel the complementary literal, keep the rest joined by ∨

question.en: Resolve the clauses (¬Human(x) ∨ Mortal(x)) and Human(Socrates).
question.bn: (¬Human(x) ∨ Mortal(x)) ও Human(Socrates) clause দুটি resolve করো।

working.en: Unify Human(x) with Human(Socrates) by {x ↦ Socrates}. The complementary pair Human/¬Human cancels, leaving the remaining literal.
working.bn: {x ↦ Socrates} দিয়ে Human(x) ও Human(Socrates) unify করি। complementary জোড়া Human/¬Human বাতিল হয়, বাকি literal থাকে।

working.en: ¬∀x (…) ≡ ∃x ¬(Student(x) → Passed(x)) ≡ ∃x (Student(x) ∧ ¬Passed(x)): there is a student who did not pass.
working.bn: ¬∀x (…) ≡ ∃x ¬(Student(x) → Passed(x)) ≡ ∃x (Student(x) ∧ ¬Passed(x)): এমন একজন student আছে যে pass করেনি।

traps.en: P → Q is false ONLY when P is true and Q is false. When P is false the implication is true no matter what Q is — 'P false, Q true' makes P → Q true, not false.
traps.bn: P → Q কেবল তখনই false যখন P true ও Q false। P false হলে Q যাই হোক implication true — 'P false, Q true' হলে P → Q true, false নয়।

traps.en: The contrapositive ¬Q → ¬P is equivalent to P → Q, but the converse Q → P and the inverse ¬P → ¬Q are NOT. Confusing them is the classic MCQ trap.
traps.bn: Contrapositive ¬Q → ¬P, P → Q-এর সমতুল্য, কিন্তু converse Q → P ও inverse ¬P → ¬Q নয়। এগুলো গুলিয়ে ফেলা ক্লাসিক MCQ ফাঁদ।

traps.en: 'All humans are mortal' is ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)), NOT ∀x (Human(x) ∧ Mortal(x)); the ∧ version wrongly says everything in the universe is both human and mortal.
traps.bn: 'All humans are mortal' হলো ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)), ∀x (Human(x) ∧ Mortal(x)) নয়; ∧ রূপটি ভুলভাবে বলে universe-এর সবকিছুই human ও mortal।

traps.en: A Horn clause has at most one POSITIVE literal (not one negative, one variable or one predicate). This is the most commonly mis-keyed definition in coaching material.
traps.bn: Horn clause-এ সর্বোচ্চ একটি POSITIVE literal থাকে (একটি negative, variable বা predicate নয়)। Coaching material-এ এই সংজ্ঞাটিই সবচেয়ে বেশি ভুল key করা হয়।

traps.en: Resolving (P ∨ Q) with (¬P ∨ R) gives (Q ∨ R) — joined by ∨, NOT (Q ∧ R). Only the complementary pair P/¬P is removed.
traps.bn: (P ∨ Q)-কে (¬P ∨ R)-এর সাথে resolve করলে পাওয়া যায় (Q ∨ R) — ∨ দিয়ে যুক্ত, (Q ∧ R) নয়। কেবল complementary জোড়া P/¬P সরানো হয়।

traps.en: A semantic network CANNOT prove anything and has no formal semantics; it only answers 'what is related to what' via inheritance/traversal. Do not treat it as a logic or a production system.
traps.bn: Semantic network কিছু prove করতে পারে না এবং এর formal semantics নেই; এটি কেবল inheritance/traversal দিয়ে 'কিসের সাথে কী সম্পর্কিত' তা বলে। একে logic বা production system ভাবা ভুল।

traps.en: Quantifier order is not interchangeable: ∃x ∀y Loves(x, y) ('someone loves everyone') is stronger than and NOT equal to ∀y ∃x Loves(x, y) ('everyone is loved by someone').
traps.bn: Quantifier-এর ক্রম বদলানো যায় না: ∃x ∀y Loves(x, y) ('someone loves everyone') শক্তিশালী এবং ∀y ∃x Loves(x, y) ('everyone is loved by someone')-এর সমান নয়।

traps.en: Modus tollens needs ¬Q together with P → Q to conclude ¬P. Concluding ¬P from ¬Q alone, or Q from ¬P alone, is the 'denying the antecedent / affirming the consequent' fallacy.
traps.bn: Modus tollens-এ ¬P পেতে ¬Q এবং P → Q দুটোই লাগে। শুধু ¬Q থেকে ¬P বা শুধু ¬P থেকে Q সিদ্ধান্ত 'denying the antecedent / affirming the consequent' fallacy।

traps.en: Backward chaining never invents facts: if the knowledge base does not support the goal it simply FAILS, it does not guess. It is goal-driven, not forward-driven.
traps.bn: Backward chaining কখনো fact বানায় না: knowledge base goal সমর্থন না করলে এটি কেবল FAIL করে, অনুমান করে না। এটি goal-driven, forward-driven নয়।

question.en: Define knowledge representation. Name four KR schemes with one strength and one weakness of each. For the knowledge base Human(Socrates) and ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)): write the clause form and use resolution refutation to prove Mortal(Socrates).
question.bn: Knowledge representation সংজ্ঞায়িত করো। চারটি KR scheme-এর প্রতিটির একটি করে strength ও weakness সহ নাম দাও। Human(Socrates) ও ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)) knowledge base-এর জন্য: clause form লেখো এবং resolution refutation দিয়ে Mortal(Socrates) prove করো।

Table of four schemes (logic, semantic network, frame, production rule) with strength + weakness
Clause form: C1 = Human(Socrates), C2 = ¬Human(x) ∨ Mortal(x)
Add negated goal C3 = ¬Mortal(Socrates); resolve C1+C2 → Mortal(Socrates); resolve with C3 → empty clause
Conclude: empty clause proves the goal; note resolution is sound and refutation-complete
bn: সংজ্ঞা: KR = reasoning-এর জন্য জগতের জ্ঞানের formal, machine-processable encoding
চারটি scheme-এর (logic, semantic network, frame, production rule) strength ও weakness সহ table
Clause form: C1 = Human(Socrates), C2 = ¬Human(x) ∨ Mortal(x)
Negated goal C3 = ¬Mortal(Socrates) যোগ; C1+C2 resolve → Mortal(Socrates); C3-এর সাথে resolve → empty clause

5.en: Define KR in one line, name four schemes, and state the resolution steps C1+C2 → Mortal(Socrates), then + ¬goal → empty clause.
5.bn: KR এক লাইনে সংজ্ঞায়িত করো, চারটি scheme-এর নাম দাও, এবং resolution ধাপ C1+C2 → Mortal(Socrates), তারপর + ¬goal → empty clause উল্লেখ করো।

10.en: Add the strength/weakness table (logic: exact but no partial knowledge; semantic net: inheritance but no formal semantics; frame: defaults but rigid; production rule: modular but slow) and the full clause-form derivation with the negated goal.
10.bn: Strength/weakness table (logic: exact কিন্তু partial knowledge নেই; semantic net: inheritance কিন্তু formal semantics নেই; frame: default কিন্তু rigid; production rule: modular কিন্তু slow) এবং negated goal সহ সম্পূর্ণ clause-form derivation যোগ করো।

20.en: Also compare all six schemes, explain the desirable KR properties (representational/inferential adequacy, efficiency, ease of acquisition), convert the KB to CNF step by step, and discuss why backward chaining suits a single-goal query here.
20.bn: ছয়টি scheme-ই তুলনা করো, desirable KR properties (representational/inferential adequacy, efficiency, ease of acquisition) ব্যাখ্যা করো, KB-কে ধাপে ধাপে CNF-এ রূপান্তর করো, এবং এখানে single-goal query-র জন্য backward chaining কেন উপযুক্ত আলোচনা করো।

question.en: What is knowledge? Draw a flow diagram showing how human knowledge is represented in a computer, and explain each stage.
question.bn: Knowledge কী? মানুষের knowledge কীভাবে computer-এ প্রকাশ করা হয় তার একটি flow diagram আঁকো এবং প্রতিটি stage ব্যাখ্যা করো।

en: Define knowledge: data organised so that conclusions can be drawn; distinguish data vs knowledge
Flow diagram: Real-world facts → Knowledge acquisition → Internal representation (logic/network/frame) → Inference engine → Output/decision
Explain each box: acquisition, choice of KR scheme, the inference loop that stores conclusions back
Example: Human(Socrates) + rule → Mortal(Socrates)
Note the two internal levels (knowledge level vs symbol/implementation level)
bn: Knowledge সংজ্ঞা: এমনভাবে সাজানো data যা থেকে সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া যায়; data vs knowledge পার্থক্য
Flow diagram: Real-world facts → Knowledge acquisition → Internal representation (logic/network/frame) → Inference engine → Output/decision
প্রতিটি box ব্যাখ্যা: acquisition, KR scheme নির্বাচন, conclusion ফেরত store করার inference loop
উদাহরণ: Human(Socrates) + rule → Mortal(Socrates)
দুটি internal level (knowledge level vs symbol/implementation level) উল্লেখ

5.en: Define knowledge in one line and draw the five-box flow (facts → acquisition → representation → inference → output).
5.bn: Knowledge এক লাইনে সংজ্ঞায়িত করো এবং পাঁচ-box flow (facts → acquisition → representation → inference → output) আঁকো।

10.en: Add the data-vs-knowledge distinction, explain each box, and give a worked inference example that stores its conclusion back in the base.
10.bn: Data-vs-knowledge পার্থক্য যোগ করো, প্রতিটি box ব্যাখ্যা করো, এবং এমন একটি worked inference উদাহরণ দাও যা তার conclusion base-এ ফেরত store করে।

question.en: What is an expert system? Explain its main components and relate them to knowledge representation.
question.bn: Expert system কী? এর প্রধান component-গুলো ব্যাখ্যা করো এবং knowledge representation-এর সাথে সম্পর্ক দেখাও।

en: Define: an AI program that emulates a human expert's decision-making in a narrow domain
Components: knowledge base (facts + production rules), inference engine (forward/backward chaining), working memory, explanation facility, user interface, knowledge-acquisition module
Link to KR: the knowledge base uses production rules / frames; inference engine applies modus ponens / chaining
Example: MYCIN-style rule 'IF symptom THEN diagnosis'
Strength (modular, explainable) and limitation (brittle, costly knowledge acquisition)
bn: সংজ্ঞা: একটি সংকীর্ণ domain-এ মানব expert-এর decision-making অনুকরণকারী AI program
Component: knowledge base (fact + production rule), inference engine (forward/backward chaining), working memory, explanation facility, user interface, knowledge-acquisition module
KR-এর সাথে সম্পর্ক: knowledge base production rule / frame ব্যবহার করে; inference engine modus ponens / chaining প্রয়োগ করে
উদাহরণ: MYCIN-ধাঁচের rule 'IF symptom THEN diagnosis'
Strength (modular, explainable) ও limitation (brittle, ব্যয়বহুল knowledge acquisition)

5.en: Define an expert system and list its components (knowledge base, inference engine, working memory, explanation facility, user interface).
5.bn: Expert system সংজ্ঞায়িত করো এবং component তালিকাভুক্ত করো (knowledge base, inference engine, working memory, explanation facility, user interface)।

10.en: Add a block diagram, explain each component, relate the knowledge base to production-rule KR and the inference engine to chaining, and give a worked IF–THEN example.
10.bn: Block diagram যোগ করো, প্রতিটি component ব্যাখ্যা করো, knowledge base-কে production-rule KR ও inference engine-কে chaining-এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত করো, এবং একটি worked IF–THEN উদাহরণ দাও।

question.en: Compare propositional logic and first-order logic. Translate the following into FOL: (i) All humans are mortal, (ii) Every member of the committee owns at least one car, (iii) Someone loves everyone. Explain why quantifier order matters.
question.bn: Propositional logic ও first-order logic তুলনা করো। নিচেরগুলো FOL-এ অনুবাদ করো: (i) All humans are mortal, (ii) Every member of the committee owns at least one car, (iii) Someone loves everyone. Quantifier-এর ক্রম কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যাখ্যা করো।

en: Comparison table: entities, quantifiers, expressiveness, cost, example
(i) ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)) — note → not ∧
(ii) ∀x (Member(x) → ∃y (Car(y) ∧ Owns(x, y)))
(iii) ∃x ∀y Loves(x, y)
Quantifier order: ∃x∀y ≠ ∀y∃x; show the two readings differ with a one-member example
bn: তুলনা table: entities, quantifiers, expressiveness, cost, example
(i) ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)) — → , ∧ নয়
(ii) ∀x (Member(x) → ∃y (Car(y) ∧ Owns(x, y)))
(iii) ∃x ∀y Loves(x, y)
Quantifier ক্রম: ∃x∀y ≠ ∀y∃x; এক-member উদাহরণে দুই reading-এর পার্থক্য দেখাও

5.en: Give the comparison table and translate (i)–(iii) correctly.
5.bn: তুলনা table দাও এবং (i)–(iii) সঠিকভাবে অনুবাদ করো।

10.en: Add why → (not ∧) is used inside ∀, the full comparison of expressiveness and cost (2ⁿ rows vs objects/relations), and the quantifier-order explanation with an example.
10.bn: ∀-এর ভিতরে কেন → (∧ নয়) ব্যবহৃত হয়, expressiveness ও cost-এর সম্পূর্ণ তুলনা (2ⁿ row বনাম object/relation), এবং উদাহরণসহ quantifier-order ব্যাখ্যা যোগ করো।

20.en: Also define WFF/sentence, unification and the MGU, show CNF conversion of (i), and explain resolution refutation and Horn-clause chaining as the inference machinery FOL enables.
20.bn: WFF/sentence, unification ও MGU সংজ্ঞায়িত করো, (i)-এর CNF রূপান্তর দেখাও, এবং FOL যে inference machinery সক্ষম করে সেই resolution refutation ও Horn-clause chaining ব্যাখ্যা করো।

q.en: What is knowledge representation in one sentence?

a.en: The formal, machine-processable encoding of world knowledge so an AI system can store and reason over it.
a.bn: জগতের জ্ঞানের formal, machine-processable encoding যাতে AI system তা store ও reason করতে পারে।

a.en: Logical (PL/FOL), semantic network, frame, production rule, script and ontology.
a.bn: Logical (PL/FOL), semantic network, frame, production rule, script এবং ontology।

q.en: Who introduced frames and in what year?
q.bn: Frame কে এবং কোন সালে চালু করেন?

a.en: Only when P is true and Q is false.
a.bn: কেবল যখন P true ও Q false।

q.en: What does resolving (P ∨ Q) with (¬P ∨ R) give?
q.bn: (P ∨ Q)-কে (¬P ∨ R)-এর সাথে resolve করলে কী পাওয়া যায়?

a.en: (Q ∨ R) — the complementary pair P/¬P cancels.
a.bn: (Q ∨ R) — complementary জোড়া P/¬P বাতিল হয়।

q.en: How do you write 'All humans are mortal' in FOL?
q.bn: FOL-এ 'All humans are mortal' কীভাবে লেখো?

a.en: A clause with at most one positive literal, i.e. H ← B₁ ∧ … ∧ Bₙ.
a.bn: সর্বোচ্চ একটি positive literal বিশিষ্ট clause, অর্থাৎ H ← B₁ ∧ … ∧ Bₙ।

q.en: Forward vs backward chaining in one line each.
q.bn: Forward বনাম backward chaining — প্রতিটি এক লাইনে।

a.en: Forward = data-driven, bottom-up from facts; backward = goal-driven, top-down from the goal.
a.bn: Forward = data-driven, fact থেকে bottom-up; backward = goal-driven, goal থেকে top-down।

q.en: What is the most general unifier of Loves(x, Bob) and Loves(Alice, y)?
q.bn: Loves(x, Bob) ও Loves(Alice, y)-এর most general unifier কী?

q.en: Why does a semantic network fail where logic succeeds?
q.bn: যেখানে logic সফল সেখানে semantic network কেন ব্যর্থ?

a.en: It has no formal semantics, so it cannot prove entailment — it only follows inheritance and graph links.
a.bn: এর formal semantics নেই, তাই এটি entailment prove করতে পারে না — কেবল inheritance ও graph link অনুসরণ করে।

q.en: What does refutation by resolution add to the clauses?
q.bn: Refutation by resolution clause-গুলোতে কী যোগ করে?

a.en: The negated goal; deriving the empty clause then proves the original goal.
a.bn: Negated goal; তারপর empty clause derive করা মূল goal prove করে।

q.en: What is the contrapositive of P → Q, and is it equivalent?
q.bn: P → Q-এর contrapositive কী, এবং এটি সমতুল্য কি?

a.en: ¬Q → ¬P, and yes it is logically equivalent to P → Q.
a.bn: ¬Q → ¬P, এবং হ্যাঁ এটি P → Q-এর logically সমতুল্য।
